svg.title: Sentiment index computation
svg.desc: Every scored pair is read with its bank, source and date, filtered to a window, weighted by source and confidence, grouped four ways (counting each sentence once in the rows that span aspects), summarised with shrinkage toward neutral, and written. A volume floor applies later, when the chatbot reads a score.

span.p:
Repeat for each window: the 7 and 30 days
to the newest sentence, and all time

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Each pair becomes
label score x confidence x source weight

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Group four ways per bank:
aspect and source, aspect blended,
source across aspects, headline ALL/ALL
across aspects: each sentence once

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weighted mean,
then shrink toward 0: score x n / (n + 5)
